record.form_source:
#-
* Four-loop physical gluon ring: q enters v1, exits v5. Ring momenta pi
* are clockwise; rungs v8->v2,v7->v3,v6->v4 carry k2,k3,k4.
* Every vertex uses incoming (p_prev,-pi,pi-p_prev) and ports(r_prev,ri,ti).
* ti=(mu,a,b,c,mu,c,b,a): repeated mu is the external metric projection.
* E=11,V=8,L=4. No fermion sign, color, couplings or denominators.
* MODE trace4/tracen selects Lorentz dimension only; no trace is evaluated.
* The graph and vertex rule are regenerated by GluonLadder.form_source().
* Input setup/sort and result checks/disposal are outside the body CPU timer.
#ifndef `LOOPS'
  #define LOOPS "4"
#endif
#if `LOOPS' != 4
  #message LOOPS must be 4
  #terminate
#endif
#ifndef `MODE'
  #define MODE "trace4"
#endif
#ifndef `ORDER'
  #define ORDER "early"
#endif
#ifndef `DIAGNOSTIC'
  #define DIAGNOSTIC "1"
#endif
#ifndef `REPEATS'
  #define REPEATS "1"
#endif
#ifndef `BATCHES'
  #define BATCHES "1"
#endif
#if `REPEATS' < 1
  #message REPEATS must be positive
  #terminate
#endif
#if `BATCHES' < 1
  #message BATCHES must be positive
  #terminate
#endif
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' < 0
  #message DIAGNOSTIC must be 0 or 1
  #terminate
#endif
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' > 1
  #message DIAGNOSTIC must be 0 or 1
  #terminate
#endif
#if "`ORDER'" != "original"
  #if "`ORDER'" != "early"
    #if "`ORDER'" != "mirror"
      #message ORDER must be original, early or mirror
      #terminate
    #endif
  #endif
#endif
Off Statistics;
Format nospaces;
Symbols D;
#if "`MODE'" == "trace4"
  Dimension 4;
#elseif "`MODE'" == "tracen"
  Dimension D;
#else
  #message MODE must be trace4 or tracen
  #terminate
#endif
Vectors k1,k2,k3,k4,q,p1,p2,p3;
Indices r1,r2,r3,r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,mu,a,b,c,i1,i2,i3;
CFunction vx;
#procedure Vertex(vertex)
id vx(`vertex',p1?,p2?,p3?,i1?,i2?,i3?)=-d_(i1,i3)*d_(p1,i2)+d_(i1,i2)*d_(p1,i3)+d_(i2,i3)*d_(p2,i1)-d_(i1,i2)*d_(p2,i3)-d_(i2,i3)*d_(p3,i1)+d_(i1,i3)*d_(p3,i2);
.sort:vertex-`vertex';
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 1
  #$terms=termsin_(F1);
  #write "STAGE=vertex-`vertex' TERMS=%$",$terms
#endif
#endprocedure
#do batch=1,`BATCHES'
#do sample=1,`REPEATS'
Local F`sample'=vx(1,k1-q,-k1,q,r8,r1,mu)*vx(2,k1,-k1-k2,k2,r1,r2,a)*vx(3,k1+k2,-k1-k2-k3,k3,r2,r3,b)*vx(4,k1+k2+k3,-k1-k2-k3-k4,k4,r3,r4,c)*vx(5,k1+k2+k3+k4,-k1-k2-k3-k4+q,-q,r4,r5,mu)*vx(6,k1+k2+k3+k4-q,-k1-k2-k3+q,-k4,r5,r6,c)*vx(7,k1+k2+k3-q,-k1-k2+q,-k3,r6,r7,b)*vx(8,k1+k2-q,-k1+q,-k2,r7,r8,a);
#enddo
.sort
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 1
  On Statistics;
#else
  #reset timer
#endif
#if "`ORDER'" == "original"
  #do vertex=1,8
    #call Vertex(`vertex')
  #enddo
#elseif "`ORDER'" == "mirror"
  #call Vertex(1)
  #call Vertex(2)
  #call Vertex(8)
  #call Vertex(3)
  #call Vertex(7)
  #call Vertex(4)
  #call Vertex(6)
  #call Vertex(5)
#else
  #call Vertex(5)
  #call Vertex(4)
  #call Vertex(6)
  #call Vertex(3)
  #call Vertex(7)
  #call Vertex(2)
  #call Vertex(8)
  #call Vertex(1)
#endif
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 0
  #write "BATCH=`batch' REPEATS=`REPEATS' BATCH_CPU_MS=`timer_'"
#endif
Off Statistics;
#$terms=termsin_(F1);
#write "MODE=`MODE' LOOPS=4 ORDER=`ORDER' STAGE=scalar TERMS=%$",$terms
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 1
  #ifdef `OUTPUT'
    #write <`OUTPUT'> "%E",F1
  #endif
#endif
#do sample=2,`REPEATS'
  Local Check`sample'=F`sample'-F1;
#enddo
.sort
#do sample=2,`REPEATS'
  #$difference=termsin_(Check`sample');
  #if `$difference' != 0
    #message Independent batch expressions disagree
    #terminate
  #endif
#enddo
#write "BATCH=`batch' EQUAL_EXPRESSIONS=`REPEATS'"
Drop;
.sort
#enddo
.end

#-
* Four-loop physical gluon ring: q enters v1, exits v5. Ring momenta pi
* are clockwise; rungs v8->v2,v7->v3,v6->v4 carry k2,k3,k4.
* Every vertex uses incoming (p_prev,-pi,pi-p_prev) and ports(r_prev,ri,ti).
* ti=(mu,a,b,c,mu,c,b,a): repeated mu is the external metric projection.
* E=11,V=8,L=4. No fermion sign, color, couplings or denominators.
* MODE trace4/tracen selects Lorentz dimension only; no trace is evaluated.
* The graph and vertex rule are regenerated by GluonLadder.form_source().
* Input setup/sort and result checks/disposal are outside the body CPU timer.
#ifndef `LOOPS'
  #define LOOPS "4"
#endif
#if `LOOPS' != 4
  #message LOOPS must be 4
  #terminate
#endif
#ifndef `MODE'
  #define MODE "trace4"
#endif
#ifndef `ORDER'
  #define ORDER "early"
#endif
#ifndef `DIAGNOSTIC'
  #define DIAGNOSTIC "1"
#endif
#ifndef `REPEATS'
  #define REPEATS "1"
#endif
#ifndef `BATCHES'
  #define BATCHES "1"
#endif
#if `REPEATS' < 1
  #message REPEATS must be positive
  #terminate
#endif
#if `BATCHES' < 1
  #message BATCHES must be positive
  #terminate
#endif
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' < 0
  #message DIAGNOSTIC must be 0 or 1
  #terminate
#endif
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' > 1
  #message DIAGNOSTIC must be 0 or 1
  #terminate
#endif
#if "`ORDER'" != "original"
  #if "`ORDER'" != "early"
    #if "`ORDER'" != "mirror"
      #message ORDER must be original, early or mirror
      #terminate
    #endif
  #endif
#endif
Off Statistics;
Format nospaces;
Symbols D;
#if "`MODE'" == "trace4"
  Dimension 4;
#elseif "`MODE'" == "tracen"
  Dimension D;
#else
  #message MODE must be trace4 or tracen
  #terminate
#endif
Vectors k1,k2,k3,k4,q,p1,p2,p3;
Indices r1,r2,r3,r4,r5,r6,r7,r8,mu,a,b,c,i1,i2,i3;
CFunction vx;
#procedure Vertex(vertex)
id vx(`vertex',p1?,p2?,p3?,i1?,i2?,i3?)=-d_(i1,i3)*d_(p1,i2)+d_(i1,i2)*d_(p1,i3)+d_(i2,i3)*d_(p2,i1)-d_(i1,i2)*d_(p2,i3)-d_(i2,i3)*d_(p3,i1)+d_(i1,i3)*d_(p3,i2);
.sort:vertex-`vertex';
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 1
  #$terms=termsin_(F1);
  #write "STAGE=vertex-`vertex' TERMS=%$",$terms
#endif
#endprocedure
#do batch=1,`BATCHES'
#do sample=1,`REPEATS'
Local F`sample'=vx(1,k1-q,-k1,q,r8,r1,mu)*vx(2,k1,-k1-k2,k2,r1,r2,a)*vx(3,k1+k2,-k1-k2-k3,k3,r2,r3,b)*vx(4,k1+k2+k3,-k1-k2-k3-k4,k4,r3,r4,c)*vx(5,k1+k2+k3+k4,-k1-k2-k3-k4+q,-q,r4,r5,mu)*vx(6,k1+k2+k3+k4-q,-k1-k2-k3+q,-k4,r5,r6,c)*vx(7,k1+k2+k3-q,-k1-k2+q,-k3,r6,r7,b)*vx(8,k1+k2-q,-k1+q,-k2,r7,r8,a);
#enddo
.sort
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 1
  On Statistics;
#else
  #reset timer
#endif
#if "`ORDER'" == "original"
  #do vertex=1,8
    #call Vertex(`vertex')
  #enddo
#elseif "`ORDER'" == "mirror"
  #call Vertex(1)
  #call Vertex(2)
  #call Vertex(8)
  #call Vertex(3)
  #call Vertex(7)
  #call Vertex(4)
  #call Vertex(6)
  #call Vertex(5)
#else
  #call Vertex(5)
  #call Vertex(4)
  #call Vertex(6)
  #call Vertex(3)
  #call Vertex(7)
  #call Vertex(2)
  #call Vertex(8)
  #call Vertex(1)
#endif
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 0
  #write "BATCH=`batch' REPEATS=`REPEATS' BATCH_CPU_MS=`timer_'"
#endif
Off Statistics;
#$terms=termsin_(F1);
#write "MODE=`MODE' LOOPS=4 ORDER=`ORDER' STAGE=scalar TERMS=%$",$terms
#if `DIAGNOSTIC' == 1
  #ifdef `OUTPUT'
    #write <`OUTPUT'> "%E",F1
  #endif
#endif
#do sample=2,`REPEATS'
  Local Check`sample'=F`sample'-F1;
#enddo
.sort
#do sample=2,`REPEATS'
  #$difference=termsin_(Check`sample');
  #if `$difference' != 0
    #message Independent batch expressions disagree
    #terminate
  #endif
#enddo
#write "BATCH=`batch' EQUAL_EXPRESSIONS=`REPEATS'"
Drop;
.sort
#enddo
.end
